sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited data type plus an empty case expression: because no value of the type can exist, the function can claim to return any type.
sketches.resonance: A complete absence cannot be contradicted, so it is allowed to become any answer without ever speaking.

sketches.mechanism: Selective receive blocks until a matching message arrives; non-matching messages are ignored and remain in the mailbox.
sketches.resonance: The process can live on while refusing every arrival that is not the one shape it waits for.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroing weak references: a weak variable does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil after the last strong reference disappears.
sketches.resonance: What is named but not held is erased as soon as the nearer grip lets go.
